description: This file defines the NetConverters class which contains multiple inner classes for converting between network-related classes such as String, InetAddress, URI, and URL. Each inner class provides conversion logic and handles exceptions appropriately. The class implements ConverterLoader, indicating it can load a set of converters for network address and URL/URI conversions.

classes.name: NetConverters
classes.description: Main class implementing ConverterLoader that registers network-related converters.

classes.name: StringToInetAddress
classes.description: Converts String to InetAddress using InetAddress.getByName.

classes.name: InetAddressToString
classes.description: Converts InetAddress to String, returning hostname if available, otherwise address.

classes.name: StringToURL
classes.description: Converts String to URL by first creating a URI and then converting to URL, handling exceptions.

methods.name: loadConverters
methods.description: Loads contained converters into the Converters registry.
